settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Follow system picks Chinese or English from the OS locale. Applies immediately after save.
settings.maptilerHint: Required for MapTiler Streets / Outdoor basemaps. Get a free key at maptiler.com.
settings.javaHeapHint: Use 4g for small areas; 6g+ for large regions; 8g on 32 GB+ machines.
settings.outputHint: OSM downloads and PMTiles are written here. Leave empty for the app default folder.

region.title: Select region
region.subtitle: Search / draw on map / import GeoJSON / edit bbox
region.drawHint: Click a tool, then draw on the map. Editing is not enabled automatically — click Edit to change vertices. Clear is above the zoom controls (bottom-right).
region.rasterHint: Assumes ~18 KB/tile for PNG streets; imagery is often larger

tasks.title: Task queue
tasks.archiveCompletedHint: Hide finished tasks from the sidebar; they remain in All tasks
tasks.renameHint: Also renames output files/folders on disk and updates stored paths. Safe for later pack/convert — avoid renaming while a pack job using this file is running.
tasks.tileHoles: Incomplete tiles: {{failed}} failed{{pending}}. Retry failed tiles before packing vector tiles.
tasks.packRasterHint: Pack the downloaded z/x/y folder into an offline archive:
tasks.mbtilesHint: SQLite · common for classic offline tools
tasks.pmtilesHint: Single file · Range requests · in-app preview
tasks.deleteWithFiles: Delete and erase files on disk
tasks.noPaths: No output/cache paths recorded; disk erase may find nothing.

download.title: Choose download type
download.taskNameHint: Defaults to the region name; used in the queue and output filenames.
download.confirmKind: What do you want to download?
download.vectorHint: Download OSM via Overpass, then build PMTiles/MBTiles
download.rasterHint: Download XYZ PNG/JPEG basemap tiles; pack folder / MBTiles later
download.expandHint: Expand each side of the selection to reduce missing OSM detail at Planetiler edges. Preview seams are often font-related; expansion is off by default.
download.sourceBlocked: “{{label}}” is not suitable for bulk offline download (policy / blocking). Prefer Carto or Esri. Continue anyway?
download.probeFailContinue: Preview failed for this source ({{error}}). Continuing may yield empty tiles or Access blocked. Submit anyway?
download.largeEstimateContinue: About {{tiles}} tiles — large size/time and possible ToS issues. Continue?
download.afterVectorHint: When finished, use “Pack vector tiles” on the task to build PMTiles or MBTiles.
download.tileEstimateWarn: About {{tiles}} tiles. Respect ToS / rate limits; pack MBTiles or PMTiles from the task card later.
